messages:
maria: Morning — quick async status for PrimeWave kernel work. What I did: landed allocator change (PR #4921) and ran a focused perf sweep on eu-west A100s. Blocker: seeing periodic KV thrash on long-tail sessions (~>50 tokens) that spikes evictions. Today: iterate on prefetch heuristics + add synthetic short-session bench by EOD.

aj: Nice. Can you paste the exact bench command and config so I can run locally?

maria: Sure — `./scripts/bench --suite primewave --concurrency 120 --profile hdr` and config we used: `batch_size=8, slot_share=0.6, kv_hot_window=60s, adaptive_prefetch=true`. Logs show repeated `kv:evict reason=slot_pressure` around 15:22 UTC.

devon: Is that on 80GB A100 cluster or the 4090 pool? Eviction semantics differ between them. Also remember the `kv_max_entries` tweak from last week.

maria: 80GB A100 nodes. kv_max_entries is 1000000 (default). The interesting bit is TTL handling — reused entries aren't being refreshed, so hot keys age out while sessions still active.

sara: I ran a repro yesterday — bumping `kv_max_size` + lowering `slot_grace` helped for short prompts. Patch diff is small, will paste the link shortly.

benchbot: quick-summary: last run (1729876480) — 1000 sessions, avg tokens/session 42, throughput 480 req/s, p50 12ms, p95 88ms, p99 220ms. Eviction events per minute: 23.

aj: Can we add a synthetic that mimics many 2-6 token sessions at high qps for the perf suite? That should surface the thrash.

maria: Yep — plan is to add a `shortburst` workload (2-6 tokens, qps 600) and run it in CI perf lane. Also pinging @devon for review on PR #4921 before I merge.

devon: I'll take a look this afternoon and leave comments. If it's small, I can approve and we can canary.

sara: PR with TTL tweak: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4992 — reduced slot_grace to 200ms and bumped kv_max_size. Patch helped my local p95 from 105ms -> 72ms on a 500-sesh run.

maria: Excellent — if CI is green I'll merge and trigger canary. Quick note: to run the local bench with the canary flags: `./scripts/run_kv_bench.sh --canary --profile hdr`.

aj: Will run it and report back if I see the same improvement. No blockers from me.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started for `primewave` on eu-west (deployment id: cw-9932).

maria: thanks team — will follow up with the CI pass and bench diffs later. If anyone wants to pair on the synthetic workload wiring, ping me and I'll DM a quick walkthrough. :raised_hands:
